properties.name: spring.jpa.database
properties.description: Target database to operate on, auto-detected by default. Can be alternatively set using the "databasePlatform" property.

properties.name: spring.jpa.database-platform
properties.description: Name of the target database to operate on, auto-detected by default. Can be alternatively set using the "Database" enum.

properties.name: spring.jpa.generate-ddl
properties.description: Whether to initialize the schema on startup.

properties.name: spring.jpa.mapping-resources
properties.description: Mapping resources (equivalent to "mapping-file" entries in persistence.xml).

properties.name: spring.jpa.open-in-view
properties.description: Register OpenEntityManagerInViewInterceptor. Binds a JPA EntityManager to the thread for the entire processing of the request.

properties.name: spring.jpa.properties
properties.description: Additional native properties to set on the JPA provider.

properties.name: spring.jpa.show-sql
properties.description: Whether to enable logging of SQL statements.
